summary: Meta announced a lease agreement with Reliance Industries for a 168 MW AI-enabled data center in Jamnagar, India, alongside new renewable energy agreements with CleanMax and Fourth Partner Energy.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement discloses a specific new data center with stated megawatt capacity and associated renewable power agreements.
mechanisms.quote: Reliance will build a data center with 168 MW capacity, which Meta will lease, with options to scale.

mechanisms.reason: Meta is committing to lease and fund a new data center facility, including covering energy and water costs, as part of its global infrastructure expansion.
mechanisms.quote: Meta will cover the full cost of the energy and water supporting the facility. This investment is a significant milestone in Meta’s global infrastructure expansion

categories.reason: Reliance is building and leasing dedicated AI data center capacity to Meta under a built-to-suit contract, fitting the neocloud hosting model.
categories.quote: Building India’s first built-to-suit AI data centre for a global technology leader of Meta’s scale demonstrates India’s readiness to be at the forefront of the global AI revolution.

notable_reason: A named 168 MW data center lease deal with a major Indian conglomerate is a concrete, disclosed infrastructure commitment relevant to power and hosting demand.
